Official-source registry. Pilot source: PIB only. Feed URL is configurable — empty means “not configured”. No AI refinement, no auto-publishing.

PIB Fetcher (foundation)

Flow: RSS/Feed → title + link + date → official URL → fetch HTML → extract raw announcement. Raw is preserved separately; successes go to the Content Inbox as RAW. Failures never create articles.

Status values: FEED_NOT_CONFIGURED · FEED_FETCH_FAILED · ARTICLE_FETCH_FAILED · CONTENT_EXTRACTION_FAILED. Fetching respects robots.txt, access restrictions and source terms; only https://pib.gov.in/ URLs are accepted.
